text:
tariq: quick ping — opened PR #3221, tiny style cleanup around imports in pkg/ingest and a proto-generated trailing-comma in the JSON marshaler. CI is failing on gofumpt. need 1 approval to merge, would appreciate a quick look when you have a minute :pray:

sam: link? i'll take a peek in a bit.

ci-bot: CI // checks: gofumpt-fmt FAILED on commit 9a7b3e2 — run `gofumpt -w` and re-push.

sam: got it, reading... looks like imports are grouped like: `"context"` then third-party then local, but one file has the local group above third-party. small reorder.

michael: this is the usual gofumpt strictness. you can run:```bash
# run from repo root
gofumpt -w ./pkg/ingest ./pkg/gen
git add -A && git commit --amend --no-edit && git push --force-with-lease
```that will fix formatting and keep history clean.

tariq: thx — i can do the amend. question: do we want me to squash the tiny proto-gen fix into the original commit or keep as separate? it was auto-generated by the proto tool.

aurora: squash is fine for a tiny generated fix. makes the changelist easier to review. if you want, push a single commit and i'll approve after CI is green.

jessica: happy to help squash if you prefer me to run the command and push. also can help re-run the local gofumpt check.

tariq: i ran the linter and amended locally, force-pushed -> updated in PR. fixed import groups and removed trailing comma in proto JSON tag.

ci-bot: CI // checks: gofumpt-fmt OK, unit-tests running...

aurora: reviewing now, quick look only.

michael: minor nit: in pkg/ingest/reader.go you switched `fmt.Errorf` -> `errors.New` in one place which changes formatting of wrapped error. please keep `fmt.Errorf("%w", err)` where wrapping is intended. not blocking, but can you keep wrap?

tariq: good catch. i'll revert that one line and force-push a tiny fix.

tariq: pushed fix for wrapping.

sam: LGTM from me — tiny formatting and one-line revert looks good.

aurora: CI green, approving now. :white_check_mark:

jessica: thanks for doing the squash and fixes, tariq.

tariq: thanks all, merging after the standard merge window. :shipit:
